prompt_template:
Locate the event of category "{category}" in this video. The category is a query condition, not a ground-truth interval.
All times are seconds relative to the first decoded video frame (time 0). The last decoded frame is at {duration_sec} seconds.
The sampled frame times in seconds are: {frame_times}.
Return only the anomalous event's start and end time in seconds in exactly this format: START=<seconds>, END=<seconds>
